name: 28185-manyprefix-qwen3next80b-tp4
model: Qwen/Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Instruct — bf16, unquantized. ~160 GB of weights, ~37.3 GiB per rank at TP4.
hardware: 4x H100 80GB HBM3 of one node (four of eight used). SM90, 132 SMs, 50 MB L2, 3.35 TB/s.
parallelism: TP=4, EP=1, PP=1, DP=1. One node, no router, no external cache tier.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=8 (pinned — do not cliff-search), warmup the first 25%, bounded at 2688 requests with a 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm synthetic_text, single turn: 448 distinct prefixes of 2048 tokens each, drawn uniformly at random per request, each followed by a 32-token question that differs per request, generating 32 tokens. Fixed lengths (both stdev 0), ignore_eos true, temperature 0.0. Seed 28185. Do not change any of the three lengths without re-measuring: the recurrent-state snapshot is taken at a 64-token granularity, and off-multiple lengths silently reuse nothing.
purpose: An 80-billion-parameter knowledge assistant answering brief questions over hundreds of long reference documents for eight concurrent users on four GPUs.
launch:
model-path: Qwen/Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Instruct
tp-size: 4
trust-remote-code: true
mem-fraction-static: 0.7

# Requires the radix cache ON -- extra_buffer raises against --disable-radix-cache -- and is
# permitted only on architectures whose ServerArgs handler allows the strategy at all.
mamba-scheduler-strategy: extra_buffer

# Pinned rather than left to the memory auto-fit, which would drift with mem-fraction-static.
max-mamba-cache-size: 256

chunked-prefill-size: 8192
random-seed: 28185
